post.description:
Cancel running agent cycle for a project and refund credits.

Uses Redis-based cancel signaling so the worker pod can detect
cancellation.  Also tries the in-memory registry as a fallback
for any tasks that might still be running in-process.

Manually trigger specific agents for a project.

Called by the frontend when the user clicks an agent suggestion button
(shown when plan_auto is OFF and the supervisor detected agents to run).

Resume the design pipeline after a user review gate.

The user clicks "Continue" in the chat after reviewing either
the first page or all pages.  Work is dispatched to the planning-agent
worker via the Redis stream (same mechanism as start_planning_task).

The Redis ``design_review_pending`` flag is best-effort: if it exists,
we clear it to prevent duplicate dispatches.  If it doesn't exist
(e.g. designs generated before the gate feature was deployed), we still
proceed — the frontend shows Continue based on design-page state, which
is the authoritative source.
